title: Relational databases
brief: Understand shared relational facts, questions and guarded changes through one shop purchase. Distinguish schema rules, atomicity, concurrent decisions, query work and durability, judge relational fit and choose a practical next route.
ownership_note: Introduce enough of each concern to choose a route; children own detailed design, formal analysis and working procedures.

title: History, correction and deletion
brief: Represent agreements and changing facts with explicit effective and recorded times. Carry corrections, retention and deletion through related and external records without rewriting the meaning of historical purchases.

neighbouring_ownership.data-modelling: Owns first current-price versus agreed-price distinction.
neighbouring_ownership.backups: Owns restoring an earlier database history and reconciling valid work.

title: Transactions and isolation
brief: Choose atomic work and isolation from the invariant being preserved. Distinguish committed visibility, statement and transaction snapshots and serial outcomes; develop sound one-row stock and multi-row capacity protocols.

neighbouring_ownership.locks: Owns explicit lock scope, ordering and wait diagnosis.
neighbouring_ownership.storage-durability: Owns how versions and logs implement physical history, without treating storage versions as business history.

title: Database access and least privilege
brief: Derive runtime, migration and support privileges from their tasks. Test tenant access as the actual trusted identity, distinguishing database authorisation, application identity and row-level integrity.

neighbouring_ownership.constraints: Owns tenant integrity and composite references.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-access: Owns native roles, row policies and privileged code.
neighbouring_ownership.crdb-operations: Owns native CockroachDB secure identities and privileges.
